definitions.gloss: statistics as a field of study
definitions.explanation: The branch of mathematics that collects and analyzes numerical data. The data and figures themselves are {統計|とうけい}.

examples.japanese: {統計学|とうけいがく}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{学|まな}ぶ→学ぶ：01987_manabu⟧。
⟦{大学|だいがく}→大学：00608_daigaku⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧{統計学|とうけいがく}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{授業|じゅぎょう}→授業：00781_jugyou⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{取|と}った→取る：00565_toru⟧。
examples.english: I took a statistics class at university.

examples.japanese: ⟦データ→データ：03944_deeta⟧⟦{分析|ぶんせき}→分析：03610_bunseki⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{仕事|しごと}→仕事：00480_shigoto⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{統計学|とうけいがく}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{知識|ちしき}→知識：01463_chishiki⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{欠|か}かせない→欠かす：10138_kakasu⟧。
examples.english: Knowledge of statistics is essential for data analysis work.
